task_summary: The agent was asked to transform an Excel workbook by sorting the A:C records according to helper column J, deduplicating repeated (B,C) pairs, and writing the result into the output range F2:H20 in /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx.

explicit: Write the modified spreadsheet to /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx using Python/openpyxl.
Only fill the sheet-level output range F2:H20, applying the helper-column J ordering rules and skipping empty cells, headers, and duplicate (B,C) pairs.
implicit: Materialize the workbook file at the exact output path before the verifier runs.
Renumber the output ITEM column sequentially instead of copying source column A verbatim.
missed_implicit: Materialize the workbook file at the exact output path before the verifier runs.
Renumber the output ITEM column sequentially instead of copying source column A verbatim.
instructions.evidence: Step 2 emitted only a Python code block, including `ws.cell(row=row_num, column=6).value = a  # Column F` and `wb.save(output_path)`, but no environment command ever created /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx. The verifier then reported `Test case 1: FAIL — Output file not found` (test_stdout.txt:886). The answer workbook also shows F values renumbered 1..10, e.g. row 2 is `[1, 'HASSAN', 133444422]` and row 11 is `[10, 'HANA', 133444425]`.

closeness_to_success.explanation: The trial never produced the required output workbook, so the verifier failed immediately. Even the drafted code in step 2 modeled F as a copy of source column A instead of a renumbered ITEM column, so the solution was not one small formatting error away from passing.

superficial_cause.summary: The required output file was never created.
superficial_cause.evidence_quote: test_stdout.txt:886: `  Test case 1: FAIL — Output file not found`

root_cause.summary: The agent stopped at drafting a Python snippet in chat instead of executing it in the environment, and the snippet itself copied source column A into output F rather than generating the sequential ITEM values that the answer workbook expects. That combines an operational failure with an incorrect mental model of the output table.
root_cause.evidence_quote: Step 2: `ws.cell(row=row_num, column=6).value = a  # Column F` and `wb.save(output_path)` were only written in the transcript; no tool call ran them.

failing_test_evidence.what_verifier_checks: The verifier first checks that `/app/output/{tc}_{task_id}_output.xlsx` exists and returns `Output file not found` if it does not (`tests/evaluate.py:174-176`, `tests/evaluate.py:205-206`). If the file exists, it compares the workbook against the answer file only in the configured range `F2:H20` from the task contract (`instruction.md:20-24`, `tests/evaluate.py:183-189`).
failing_test_evidence.what_agent_produced: The transcript contains only a Python code block in step 2; there is no terminal/tool action that actually writes `/app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx`. The verifier therefore found no output workbook at all.
failing_test_evidence.exact_failure_quote: Test case 1: FAIL — Output file not found

super_capable_counterfactual.claim: If the agent had run a correct Python/openpyxl script that wrote the sorted, deduplicated rows to /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx with F numbered sequentially 1..10, instead of only pasting code and stopping, the trial would have passed.
super_capable_counterfactual.X: Execute a script in the environment that loads /app/spreadsheets/1_22-47_input.xlsx, constructs the output table with renumbered ITEM values, and saves /app/output/1_22-47_output.xlsx.
super_capable_counterfactual.Y: It only emitted a code snippet in the transcript and never created the workbook file.

issues: The prompt is noisy and does not explicitly say that the ITEM column in F should be renumbered sequentially, but the answer workbook requires that behavior.
The source sheet contains repeated table blocks, which makes the intended source region harder to infer even though the verifier contract is consistent.

notes_for_aggregation: This trial is easy to misclassify as a simple logic miss, but the decisive failure is operational: no output workbook was produced. The drafted algorithm would also have been wrong because it copied source A into F instead of generating the sequential ITEM column expected by the answer file.
